analyticalQuestion: Can the R0.69A periodic packet support a singularity mechanism through transverse perturbations that vanish in a scale-critical topology?
supportedClaim: The packet's periodic BMO^-1 upper bound decays geometrically, so sufficiently deep packets plus a fixed critical ball of transverse perturbations lie in the standard small-data regime.
claimBoundary: source-bound critical-smallness and transverse-stability reduction for the R0.69A periodic packet; not a singularity or general three-dimensional regularity theorem

target budget and first sufficient packet depth
pinned certificates and directed interval metadata

computation.configuration: R0.69A packet family for depths 0 through 50 and target budgets 1 through 1e-6
computation.precision: exact rational inputs and 256-bit directed MPFR arithmetic
